show_project_session_and_result_after_ea: Show project, session and result after each turn. Click a notification to return to its session.
keep_this_page_and_browser_open_backgrou: Keep this page and browser open. Background tabs can receive notifications, but frozen or discarded pages may not notify promptly. Results and unread indicators sync when you return.
chrome_settings_performance_always_keep_: Chrome: Settings → Performance → Always keep these sites active. Add this site.
edge_settings_system_and_performance_per: Edge: Settings → System and performance → Performance → Always keep these sites active (or never put them to sleep). Add this site.
configure_this_manually_in_the_browser_n: Configure this manually in the browser; names may vary by version.
allow_notifications_in_the_browser_s_sit: Allow notifications in the browser's site settings, then enable them here.
use_https_localhost_or_127_0_0_1: Use HTTPS. localhost or 127.0.0.1 can be used for local access.
use_a_desktop_browser_that_supports_syst: Use a desktop browser that supports system notifications. In-page status and unread indicators remain available.
permission_is_requested_only_when_you_cl: Permission is requested only when you click Enable. This setting is shared across this site's tabs in this browser.
cannot_save_notification_settings_allow_: Cannot save notification settings. Allow browser storage for this site and retry.
cannot_enable_notifications_check_notifi: Cannot enable notifications. Check notification permissions and site storage settings.
the_browser_could_not_show_notifications: The browser could not show notifications. Check browser and system settings. In-page status and unread indicators remain available.
cannot_show_notifications_or_save_dedupl: Cannot show notifications or save deduplication records. Check notification permissions and site storage. In-page status and unread indicators remain available.
project_session_and_completion_status_wi: Project, session and completion status will appear here when the agent finishes.
this_browser_cannot_show_system_notifica: This browser cannot show system notifications. Check browser and system settings.
notification_records_are_in_use_by_anoth: Notification records are in use by another page. Close old pages and retry.
